newsitem.title: UK: Dollar pauses for breath at midday in Europe.
newsitem.headline: Dollar pauses for breath at midday in Europe.

text.p: The dollar paused for breath below new 40-month peaks shy of 1.75 marks and 115 yen at midday in Europe, well supported ahead of the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meeting on Tuesday and Wednesday.
U.S. figures showing robust economic growth and belief that Europe's single currency will be soft from the outset boosted dollar/mark to 40-month peaks of 1.7488 earlier in Europe.

"I think the soft deutschmark scenario will dominate, for the time being. But, in all honesty, I think we are now on hold for much of this week," said David Coleman, chief economist at CIBC Wood Gundy.
